I have been receiving Botox treatments for over 12 years, and this was truly the best experience I have ever had.

From the moment I arrived, Dr Pongsak and staff were incredibly warm, professional, and knowledgeable. They made me feel comfortable right away, almost as if I had been their patient for years. The entire team was attentive, kind, and took the time to explain everything clearly before beginning treatment.

One detail that impressed me greatly was their commitment to transparency and safety. They showed me the unopened box of Botox before preparing the injections, which gave me complete confidence that the product was authentic and freshly opened. That level of professionalism and care is rare.

The facility itself is modern, clean, and very well run. I also noticed a steady flow of patients coming and going, many of whom appeared to be locals, which is always a great sign of a trusted clinic.

As someone who has worked in the beauty industry for more than three decades, I am very particular about who I trust with aesthetic treatments. I can honestly say I felt completely safe and in excellent hands here.

I am beyond pleased with my results and my experience. In fact, I am already planning to return for additional treatments in the future.

Pongsak Clinic Review (Eyelid Surgery + HIFU & IPL)

I originally went to Pongsak Clinic for a consultation about ptosis surgery on my right eyelid. First and foremost the customer service is world class. The staff are so warm, welcoming, and genuinely kind that you forget you’re even in a cosmetic clinic.

My consultation went amazing. The doctor was very knowledgeable, took time to answer every question, listened to all my concerns, and gave his honest medical opinion. I instantly felt confident I was in good hands, so I went ahead and scheduled the surgery for the following week.

Surgery day came, and even though I usually get nervous, the staff made me feel completely at ease. The doctor was meticulous with his work precise incision, gentle technique, and the results were beautiful. Two weeks later, my eyelid functions perfectly and looks completely natural. I’m so happy with how it turned out, and I know it’s only going to get better as it heals.

Now, let’s talk about the beauty side of things make sure you pay attention to all the gorgeous women working there because they’re walking skincare goals .I immediately asked about sun damage and how to keep my skin looking youthful. Even though I’m in my I still want to feel confident and fresh …especially in Thailand’s heat, where I don’t always want to wear makeup.

They gave me a personalized skincare regimen and suggested two treatments HIFU and IPL, which I got done right after my stitches were removed. It’s only been a few days, and I can already see my skin improving smoother, brighter, and tighter.

You can go to any skin clinic and get basic treatments, but what sets Pongsak apart is their honesty and professionalism. They don’t try to upsell you on unnecessary services. Their bedside manner, transparency, and genuine care for their clients are what make them stand out.

Overall 10/10 experience. Highly recommend this clinic to anyone considering cosmetic or skincare treatments in Hua Hin. 💕
